githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 4 replaces the fixed accent palette with a shareable Theme Designer for custom one- to five-color gradients. It also refreshes the emoji and GIF pickers with new context-menu actions and Discord-synced emoji favorites, and includes focused messaging and navigation fixes.

## Theme Designer and sharing

- Replaced the fixed accent choices with a Theme Designer that supports one to five ordered colors, adjustable hues, theme intensity and brightness, and randomized combinations.
- Applied the chosen gradient and adaptive accent across the workspace, Settings, sign-in, account switching, loading, member-list, and other native surfaces in System, Light, and Dark appearances.
- Added copyable `sakuracord.app` theme links. Shared themes appear in conversations as native cards with palette previews and an Apply Theme button that changes both the gradient and appearance.
- Added native update action cards and versioned theme-link handling, so a theme that requires a newer format offers a signed update check instead of applying incomplete settings.

## Emoji and GIF pickers

- Refreshed the emoji and GIF pickers with consistent native search headers, cleaner navigation, and simplified presentation.
- Improved picker focus and Escape behavior so searches clear before dismissal, GIF results return to their category view, and the composer regains focus reliably.
- Moved emoji favorites from local-only storage to Discord account settings and reconciled live favorite changes from Discord.
- Added emoji context menus for favorite actions and copying native emoji, custom emoji IDs, or custom emoji image links.
- Added GIF context menus in both the picker and message timeline for favorite actions and copying GIF links.

## Messaging and fixes

- Raised the base Discord attachment limit from 10 MB to 20 MB.
- Enabled standard Undo in the message composer.
- Fixed the default search shortcuts so Command-F searches the current conversation and Shift-Command-F opens broader message search.
- Fixed member-list role-indicator alignment and adapted uncolored roles to the active theme.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-3...v0.1.5-Beta-4](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-3...v0.1.5-Beta-4)
discordAnnouncement:
**Custom themes and refreshed emoji and GIF pickers 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Design one- to five-color gradients, tune intensity and brightness, or generate a randomized theme
- Copy a theme link so it appears in chat with a palette preview and one-click Apply Theme action
- Refreshed emoji and GIF pickers with cleaner native search, navigation, focus, and Escape behavior
- Right-click emoji or GIFs for new copy and favorite actions, with emoji favorites synced through Discord
- Free accounts can upload files up to 20 MB, and the composer now supports Undo
- Fixed the default search shortcuts: Command-F searches the current conversation and Shift-Command-F opens broader message search
